answer: Voting weight comes only from exclusive, scarce leases: each identity must hold one unique endpoint for 21 days and lock 80 tokens against it. The registry refuses a second claim on the same slot, and a proven double-holder burns both bonds. Standing up a thousand aliases therefore means buying a thousand distinct leases and keeping 80,000 tokens immobilized through the vote. The willow station on the merchant ridge publishes a public mirror of every live lease, so a colliding claim is rejected before it can attest.
